limitations: Fresh one-arm process/one model/seed/fixed teacher stream. RSS samples lowerbound; VmHWM includes model load. Explicit requested pinned root bytes exclude allocator rounding/retained blocks; no public pinned allocator stats in Torch2.5. Hostflush RSS difference descriptive, not exact pinned cache size. Canonical state hash after measured generation; GPU peaks include model/query scoring/attention. Unequal host resources; NarrativeQA NI remains unproven, no promotion/fairbaseline/speed/physicalSTT claim.
actual_limitations: Live owned pinned allocation ranges measured through the public CUDA driver API. Excludes other cached host blocks and GPU-driver allocations; RSS samples lowerbound and VmHWM includes imports/model load. GPU allocated/reserved peaks measured separately for prefill/decode. Same old fresh-process fixed teacher stream, not timing/quality/physical STT or resource equality proof.

loaded_model_snapshot.limitations: Public allocator snapshots; segment association is not causal attribution. Excludes non-Torch/driver allocations.

decode_final_snapshot.limitations: Public allocator snapshots; segment association is not causal attribution. Excludes non-Torch/driver allocations.

observer_limitations: Primitive public snapshots and weak storage handles retain no GPU payload/model owners. Observer timings invalid; no superiority/quality/physicalSTT claim. Other host/driver scopes excluded.
fresh_owner_limits: Same frozen fresh caller and standard host allocator. Ordinary BulkPromotionPolicy versus frozen PrefillSharedPolicy/scoped OwnerRelease. No prefill cleanup, exact-root or VMM. Untimed resource/preservation audit; no full-resource equality, quality superiority or ordinary adoption.
